page.description: MX Linux editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.intro: A Debian stable desktop with its own tools, published in three editions. Pick Xfce, Fluxbox or KDE, then write the 64-bit image to a stick.
pros: Debian stable base with MX's own configuration tools.
Three editions: Xfce, Fluxbox and KDE Plasma.
A separate AHS image exists for newer hardware.
Live session before installing, with the installer on the same ISO.
cons: Three editions to choose between; none is a default for everyone.
The project blog was unreachable for this check, so the date is the mirror file date.
page.previewNote: A stock screenshot of MX Linux 18.3 from Wikimedia Commons. It is not 25.3 and not a ROMinit recording: no image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted for this page.

shot.alt: MX Linux 18.3 default Xfce desktop with the panel at the bottom
shot.caption: Stock screenshot of MX Linux 18.3 · not 25.3, no USB written, no boot tested.

page.status: One path per edition: the 64-bit ISO, written with dd or any image writer. Writing erases the stick; the installer then partitions or erases the target disk. The release date is the official mirror's file date (2026-09-20); the project's own announcement was unreachable for this check.
